title: mise-en-place toolchain
description: Adds mise.toml pinning Node 24 for skill scripts and MCP servers; stack templates add their runtime under [tools], and personal overrides go in the gitignored mise.local.toml.

content: # Toolchain pins for this repository, installed with `mise install`.
# Personal overrides (extra tools, local env) go in mise.local.toml, which is gitignored.

hooks.label: Install the pinned toolchain
hooks.description: Trusts mise.toml and installs every tool it pins. Idempotent; re-runs when mise.toml changes.
